# 1 · Reading of the Reference

<details>
<summary><strong>Directly visible facts</strong> (expand)</summary>

- Warm ivory full-bleed canvas with paper grain; no browser chrome.
- Two-region top composition: a printed-spec left column and a tall floating document panel on the right, separated by a faint vertical hairline with six gold numbered callout badges sitting in the gutter, aligned to panel regions.
- Left column order: `COMPONENT` eyebrow → serif `Document Panel` → italic `Right Rail – Primary Workspace` → intro paragraph → rule → `ANATOMY` (6 numbered items) → `VARIANTS` (3 thumbnail rows) → `BEHAVIOR` (4 bullets) → `ACCESSIBILITY` (4 bullets).
- Full-width `COMPONENT API` table at the bottom: Prop / Type / Required / Default / Description, 10 rows, ruled grid, monospace-ish cells.
- Panel: rounded shell, darker tab strip with 3 uppercase tabs (`NOTES` active/raised) + close ✕; header `Research Notebook ⌄` with `+` and `⋮`; icon toolbar in 5 groups + `Templates` button; inset lighter paper editor canvas; then `Linked Records` (2×2 dark cards), `Quick Notes` (3 sticky notes: gold/green/blue), `Related Notes` (3 rows + `＋ New Note`).
- Editor canvas: serif title, 4 tag pills + `+`, three numbered sub-sections (Core Premise / Supporting Threads / Key Questions), a yellow highlight run, an underlined phrase, square bullets, empty checkboxes, a gold vertical clip bar at the left edge, a ✦ mark, and two handwritten annotations in the right margin (one free, one boxed).
</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>High-confidence inferences</strong></summary>

- Design width ≈ **1204px** (mock 602px × 2). Left column ≈ 376px, gutter ≈ 56px, panel ≈ 684px.
- Panel interior padding 28px; editor canvas inner text column ≈ 372px with a ≈200px annotation margin.
- Fonts: transitional serif (Spectral), neutral sans (Inter), casual script (Caveat), technical mono (IBM Plex Mono).
</details>

# 3 · Implementation

### `app/layout.tsx`

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next"
import { Spectral, Inter, Caveat, IBM_Plex_Mono } from "next/font/google"
import "./globals.css"
import "../styles/document-panel.css"

const editorial = Spectral({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["300", "400", "500", "600", "700"],
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  variable: "--font-editorial-src",
  display: "swap",
})

const iface = Inter({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"],
  variable: "--font-interface-src",
  display: "swap",
})

const handwritten = Caveat({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  variable: "--font-handwritten-src",
  display: "swap",
})

const technical = IBM_Plex_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  variable: "--font-technical-src",
  display: "swap",
})

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Document Panel — Component Specification",
  description:
    "Printed-style design-system specification sheet for the Document Panel right-rail workspace component.",
}

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${editorial.variable} ${iface.variable} ${handwritten.variable} ${technical.variable}`}
    >
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

```css
/* =========================================================================
   DOCUMENT PANEL — SEMANTIC DESIGN TOKENS
   All measurements are px unless structurally required otherwise.
   ========================================================================= */

:root {
  /* ---- Typography families -------------------------------------------- */
  --font-editorial: var(--font-editorial-src), "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype",
    Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-interface: var(--font-interface-src), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,

  --font-handwritten: var(--font-handwritten-src), "Segoe Script", "Bradley Hand",
    cursive;
  --font-technical: var(--font-technical-src), ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular",
    "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, monospace;

  /* ---- Colour --------------------------------------------------------- */
  --canvas: #f1ebde;
  --canvas-deep: #e9e1d0;
  --paper: #fbf7ee;
  --paper-deep: #ece4d3;
  --paper-panel: #f3ede0;
  --paper-tab: #e8e0ce;

  --ink: #2c2721;
  --ink-strong: #1c1915;
  --ink-muted: #7c7367;
  --ink-faint: #9c9285;

  --line: #ded4c1;
  --line-soft: #e8e0d1;
  --line-strong: #c8bba3;
  --line-rule: #d5c9b4;

  --gold: #ac8547;
  --gold-deep: #8a6a33;
  --gold-soft: #e4d3ab;
  --gold-wash: #f2e6c9;
  --highlight: #f4dc93;

  --record-surface: #2f2a24;
  --record-surface-hover: #3a342c;
  --record-surface-active: #453d33;
  --record-border: #4b4339;
  --record-ink: #f3eee3;
  --record-ink-muted: #a79d8e;

  --note-gold: #e8d59b;
  --note-gold-edge: #d3bd7d;
  --note-green: #cbdabc;
  --note-green-edge: #b3c6a1;
  --note-blue: #bdd3e2;
  --note-blue-edge: #a3bed1;

  --focus-ring: #ac8547;

  /* ---- Layout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  --canvas-max: 1204px;
  --canvas-pad-x: 24px;
  --canvas-pad-top: 26px;
  --canvas-pad-bottom: 34px;

  --col-spec: 376px;
  --col-gutter: 56px;

  --panel-width: 684px;
  --panel-min-width: 560px;
  --panel-max-width: 780px;
  --panel-pad-x: 28px;
  --panel-section-gap: 26px;

  /* ---- Radii ---------------------------------------------------------- */
  --r-panel: 14px;
  --r-tab: 8px;
  --r-canvas: 6px;
  --r-card: 6px;
  --r-note: 3px;
  --r-control: 5px;
  --r-pill: 999px;

  /* ---- Borders -------------------------------------------------------- */
  --bw-hairline: 1px;
  --bw-strong: 1.5px;

  /* ---- Shadows -------------------------------------------------------- */
  --shadow-panel: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.05), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.14),
    0 22px 44px -20px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.24);
  --shadow-panel-hover: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.06),
    0 8px 18px -6px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.16), 0 28px 52px -20px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.28);
  --shadow-canvas: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.07), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.7) inset;
  --shadow-record: 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 18, 8, 0.2);
  --shadow-record-hover: 0 2px 5px rgba(24, 18, 8, 0.26);
  --shadow-note: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.1), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.2);
  --shadow-note-hover: 0 2px 3px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.12), 0 7px 14px -5px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.24);
  --shadow-inset-top: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);

  /* ---- Focus ---------------------------------------------------------- */
  --focus-width: 2px;
  --focus-offset: 2px;

  /* ---- Z-index map ---------------------------------------------------- */
  --z-canvas: 0;
  --z-divider: 1;
  --z-panel-shadow: 5;
  --z-panel: 10;
  --z-panel-content: 20;
  --z-sticky-header: 30;
  --z-toolbar: 35;
  --z-annotations: 40;
  --z-popover: 50;

  /* ---- Motion --------------------------------------------------------- */
  --dur-fast: 120ms;
  --dur-base: 180ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0.3, 1);
}

/* =========================================================================
   PAGE CANVAS + TEXTURE
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-page {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-canvas);
  min-height: 100%;
  background-color: var(--canvas);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 0%, rgba(255, 252, 244, 0.9), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(100% 60% at 8% 100%, rgba(196, 176, 141, 0.16), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(100% 60% at 92% 88%, rgba(196, 176, 141, 0.13), transparent 60%);
}

.dp-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-divider);
  opacity: 0.5;
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.032) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.024) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(37deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.016) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px);
}

/* Reusable restrained grain for paper surfaces */
.dp-grain {
  position: relative;
}
.dp-grain::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.55;
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.026) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.02) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px);
}

/* =========================================================================
   SHELL GRID
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-shellgrid {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--canvas-max);
  padding: var(--canvas-pad-top) var(--canvas-pad-x) var(--canvas-pad-bottom);
}

.dp-top {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--col-spec) var(--col-gutter) minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  column-gap: 0;
}

.dp-divider {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-divider);
  justify-self: start;
  margin-left: 15px;
  width: 1px;
  min-height: 100%;
  align-self: stretch;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent 0,
    var(--line) 14px,
    var(--line) calc(100% - 40px),
    transparent 100%
  );
}

/* =========================================================================
   CALLOUT BADGES (gutter)

.dp-callout {
  position: absolute;
  left: -42px;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;

  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  background: var(--gold);
  color: #fdf9f0;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* =========================================================================
   PANEL
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-panel-col {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.dp-panel-outer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-panel);
  isolation: isolate;
}

.dp-shell {
  position: relative;
  border: var(--bw-hairline) solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-panel);
  background: var(--paper-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel), var(--shadow-inset-top);
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-shell:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel-hover), var(--shadow-inset-top);
}

/* --- Tab bar --- */
.dp-tabbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-sticky-header);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 50px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
  border-radius: calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) 0 0;
  background: var(--paper-tab);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset-top);
}

.dp-tab {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  min-width: 96px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-tab) var(--r-tab) 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tab:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.5);
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--paper-panel);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset;
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--paper-panel);
}

.dp-tabclose {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

/* --- Header --- */
.dp-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.dp-doc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.004em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-savestate {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* --- Toolbar --- */
.dp-toolbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-toolbar);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.55), rgba(255, 253, 246, 0));
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.dp-toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.dp-tool {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  color: #625a4f;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tool:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-tool:active {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.dp-tool[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tool:disabled {
  opacity: 0.38;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.dp-tool-sep {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 1px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0 5px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-templates {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #5b5348;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) inset;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-templates:hover {
  background: #fffdf6;
}

/* --- Body --- */
.dp-body {
  padding: 16px var(--panel-pad-x) 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--panel-section-gap);
}

/* =========================================================================
   EDITOR CANVAS
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-canvas {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-canvas);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-canvas);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dp-canvas-scroll {
  position: relative;
  max-height: 620px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 22px 28px 26px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--paper);
}

.dp-canvas-corner {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
}
.dp-canvas-corner--l {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
  border-right: 1px solid transparent;
}
.dp-canvas-corner--r {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(225deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
}

.dp-doc-h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 26px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.008em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-column {
  max-width: 372px;
}

.dp-tagrow {
  margin-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.dp-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 19px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #f4efe3;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: #5f574c;
}
.dp-tag--gold {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tag-add {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-tag-add:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-doc-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-doc-p {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: #4f483e;
}

.dp-mark {
  background: var(--highlight);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  margin: 0 -2px;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}

.dp-underline {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #8b8272;
  padding-bottom: 0.5px;
}

.dp-doc-ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-doc-li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-doc-li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 6px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 0.5px;
}

.dp-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 1.5px 0;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-check-box {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 2px;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #fffdf7;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-check[data-checked="true"] .dp-check-box {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-check[data-checked="true"] .dp-check-label {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* --- Paperclip / clip detail --- */
.dp-clip {
  position: absolute;
  left: 13px;
  width: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d8b878, var(--gold));
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.28), inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-clip-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 14px;
  color: var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(28deg);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.3));
}

/* --- Handwritten annotations --- */
.dp-annotation {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  color: #4a4235;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-hand-1 {
  top: 44px;
  right: 6px;
  width: 132px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-2.2deg);
}
.dp-hand-squiggle {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1px;
  width: 82px;
  height: 5px;
  color: #6d6353;
}
.dp-hand-star {
  top: 178px;
  right: 148px;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  transform: rotate(6deg);
}
.dp-hand-box {
  top: 300px;
  right: 8px;
  width: 142px;
  padding: 9px 11px 11px;
  border: 1px solid #a9bcc9;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(228, 238, 244, 0.5);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-1.6deg);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.08);
}

/* =========================================================================
   PANEL SECTIONS
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-section {
  position: relative;
}

.dp-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.dp-section-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 2px 2px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-toggle svg {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-toggle[aria-expanded="false"] svg {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.dp-section-rule {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-section-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6b6357;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-action:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis:hover {
  background: #f7ecd4;
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-collapse {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows var(--dur-base) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-collapse[data-open="false"] {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
}
.dp-collapse > div {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}

.dp-empty {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 14px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.42);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* --- Linked record grid --- */
.dp-record-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px 16px;
}

.dp-record {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--record-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: var(--record-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-record:hover {
  background: var(--record-surface-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.dp-record[data-selected="true"] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--record-surface-active);
}
.dp-record-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.35);
  background: rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.14);
  color: #d3ad६9;
  color: #d3ad69;
}
.dp-record-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--record-ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-meta {
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 13px;
  color: var(--record-ink-muted);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-check {
  margin-left: 4px;
  color: var(--gold);
}

/* --- Sticky notes --- */
.dp-note-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}

.dp-note {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  min-height: 148px;
  padding: 11px 12px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-note);
  border: 1px solid var(--tone-edge);
  background: var(--tone-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-note:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1.5px);
}
.dp-note::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 34%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(90, 72, 40, 0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
}
.dp-note-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #3a332a;
}
.dp-note-body {
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  color: #3f382d;
}
.dp-note-sign {
  margin-top: auto;
  align-self: flex-end;
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #4c4436;
}

/* --- Related note rows --- */
.dp-related-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-related-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 8px 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.72);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-related-row:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}
.dp-related-row[data-selected="true"] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-related-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-related-meta {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* =========================================================================
   SHARED CONTROLS
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-iconbtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  color: #625a4f;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-iconbtn:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: transparent;
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost:hover {
  border-color: var(--line);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.85);
}
.dp-iconbtn--dim {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-titlebtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 4px 2px 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-titlebtn:hover .dp-doc-title {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

/* --- Focus visible (global, non-colour-only) --- */
.dp-page :where(button, [role="tab"], [role="separator"], a, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
}

/* =========================================================================
   RESIZE HANDLE
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-resize {
  position: absolute;
  top: 60px;
  bottom: 60px;
  left: -13px;
  width: 12px;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: col-resize;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  touch-action: none;
}
.dp-resize::after {
  content: "";
  width: 3px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-resize:hover::after,
.dp-resize:focus-visible::after,
.dp-resize[data-dragging="true"]::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* =========================================================================
   PANEL CLOSED PLACEHOLDER
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-closed {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 300px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-panel);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.4);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-restore {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* =========================================================================
   COMPONENT API TABLE
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-api {
  margin-top: 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line-rule);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.dp-api-label {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dp-api-scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.55);
}

.dp-api-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 900px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: var(--font-technical);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 14px;
}
.dp-api-table thead th {
  text-align: left;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-api-table thead th:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  color: #564f45;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(236, 228, 211, 0.28);
}
.dp-api-prop {
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.dp-api-req {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dp-col-prop {
  width: 170px;
}
.dp-col-type {
  width: 190px;
}
.dp-col-req {
  width: 110px;
}
.dp-col-def {
  width: 120px;
}

/* =========================================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================================= */

@media (max-width: 1203px) {
  :root {
    --canvas-pad-x: 20px;
    --col-spec: 330px;
    --col-gutter: 44px;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: -34px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  :root {
    --canvas-pad-x: 18px;
    --col-spec: 300px;
    --col-gutter: 40px;
    --panel-pad-x: 20px;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 58%;
  }
  .dp-hand-1,
  .dp-hand-box {
    width: 118px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .dp-top {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    row-gap: 30px;
  }
  .dp-divider {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: 0;
    top: -24px;
  }
  .dp-panel-outer {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-resize {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-annotation {
    position: static;
    display: block;
    width: auto;
    transform: none;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
  .dp-hand-star {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .dp-record-grid,
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .spec-title {
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 32px;
  }
  .dp-tab {
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 12px;
    font-size: 9px;
  }
}

/* =========================================================================
   REDUCED MOTION / HIGH CONTRAST
   ========================================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dp-page *,
  .dp-page *::before,
  .dp-page *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .dp-collapse {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .dp-shell,
  .dp-canvas,
  .dp-record,
  .dp-note,
  .dp-related-row,
  .dp-api-scroll {
    border: 1px solid CanvasText;
  }
  .dp-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
    border: 1px solid Highlight;
  }
  .dp-page::before,
  .dp-grain::after,
  .dp-note::before {
    display: none;
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { Config } from "tailwindcss"

const config: Config = {

        "line-strong": "var(--line-strong)",

        "record-surface": "var(--record-surface)",
        "record-border": "var(--record-border)",
      },
      fontFamily: {
        editorial: "var(--font-editorial)",

      },

  },
  plugins: [],
}

export default config
```

### `lib/utils.ts`

```ts
export function cx(...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>): string {
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(" ")
}

export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max)
}
```

### `lib/document-panel-data.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import { FileText, Radar, ScrollText, FolderClosed } from "lucide-react"

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- types */

export type PanelTab = {
  id: string
  label: string
}

export type LinkedRecord = {
  id: string
  title: string
  type: string
  date: string
  icon: React.ReactNode
}

export type QuickNote = {
  id: string
  category: string
  body: string
  signature?: string
  tone: "gold" | "green" | "blue"
}

export type RelatedNote = {
  id: string
  title: string
  updatedLabel: string
}

export type AnatomyItem = {
  number: number
  title: string
```

### `components/panel-tab-bar.tsx`

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { X } from "lucide-react"
import type { PanelTab } from "@/lib/document-panel-data"

type PanelTabBarProps = {
  tabs: PanelTab[]
  activeTabId: string
  onSelect: (id: string) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

export function PanelTabBar({ tabs, activeTabId, onSelect, onClose }: PanelTabBarProps) {
  const refs = React.useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([])

  function handleKeyDown(event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) {
    let next = index
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (index + 1) % tabs.length
    else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length
    else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0
    else if (event.key === "End") next = tabs.length - 1
    else return

    event.preventDefault()
    onSelect(tabs[next].id)
    refs.current[next]?.focus()
  }

  return (
    <div className="dp-tabbar">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Document panel views" style={{ display: "flex", gap: "2px" }}>
        {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
          const selected = tab.id === activeTabId
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              ref={(node) => {
                refs.current[index] = node
              }}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id={`dp-tab-${tab.id}`}
              aria-selected={selected}
              aria-controls={`dp-tabpanel-${tab.id}`}
              tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
              className="dp-tab"
              onClick={() => onSelect(tab.id)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => handleKeyDown(event, index)}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        className="dp-iconbtn dp-iconbtn--ghost dp-iconbtn--dim dp-tabclose"
        aria-label="Close document panel"
        onClick={onClose}
      >
        <X width={14} height={14} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { ChevronDown, MoreVertical, Plus } from "lucide-react"

export type SaveState = "idle" | "saving" | "saved"

type DocumentPanelHeaderProps = {
  title: string
  saveState: SaveState
  onToggleTitleMenu: () => void
  onAdd: () => void
  onOverflow: () => void
}

export function DocumentPanelHeader({
  title,
  saveState,
  onToggleTitleMenu,
  onAdd,
  onOverflow,
}: DocumentPanelHeaderProps) {
  return (
    <div className="dp-header">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="dp-titlebtn"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-label={`${title} — document options`}
        onClick={onToggleTitleMenu}
      >
        <h2 className="dp-doc-title">{title}</h2>
        <ChevronDown width={14} height={14} strokeWidth={1.9} aria-hidden />
      </button>

      {saveState !== "idle" ? (
        <span className="dp-savestate" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          {saveState === "saving" ? "Saving…" : "Saved"}
        </span>
      ) : null}

      <div style={{ marginLeft: "auto", display: "flex", gap: "6px" }}>
        <button type="button" className="dp-iconbtn" aria-label="Add to notebook" onClick={onAdd}>
          <Plus width={13} height={13} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden />

        <button
          type="button"

          aria-haspopup="menu"
          onClick={onOverflow}
        >
          <MoreVertical width={13} height={13} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `components/document-toolbar.tsx`

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import {
  AtSign,
  Bold,
  Heading1,
  Heading2,
  Heading3,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  IndentIncrease,
  Italic,
  LayoutTemplate,
  Link2,
  List,
  ListChecks,
  ListOrdered,
  Quote,
  Table2,
  Underline,
} from "lucide-react"

type ToolId =
  | "h1" | "h2" | "h3"
  | "bold" | "italic" | "underline"
  | "ul" | "ol" | "checklist"
  | "indent" | "table" | "image"
  | "quote" | "mention" | "link"

type Tool = {
  id: ToolId
  label: string
  icon: React.ReactNode
  toggle?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

const ICON = { width: 14, height: 14, strokeWidth: 1.8 } as const

const TOOL_GROUPS: Tool[][] = [
  [
    { id: "h1", label: "Heading 1", icon: <Heading1 {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "h2", label: "Heading 2", icon: <Heading2 {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "h3", label: "Heading 3", icon: <Heading3 {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
  ],
  [
    { id: "bold", label: "Bold", icon: <Bold {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "italic", label: "Italic", icon: <Italic {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "underline", label: "Underline", icon: <Underline {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
  ],
  [
    { id: "ul", label: "Bulleted list", icon: <List {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "ol", label: "Numbered list", icon: <ListOrdered {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "checklist", label: "Checklist", icon: <ListChecks {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
  ],
  [
    { id: "indent", label: "Increase indent", icon: <IndentIncrease {...ICON} aria-hidden /> },
    { id: "table", label: "Insert table", icon: <Table2 {...ICON} aria-hidden /> },
    { id: "image", label: "Insert image", icon: <ImageIcon {...ICON} aria-hidden />, disabled: true },
  ],
  [
    { id: "quote", label: "Block quote", icon: <Quote {...ICON} aria-hidden />, toggle: true },
    { id: "mention", label: "Mention record", icon: <AtSign {...ICON} aria-hidden /> },
    { id: "link", label: "Insert link", icon: <Link2 {...ICON} aria-hidden /> },
  ],
]

type DocumentToolbarProps = {
  activeTools: ReadonlySet<ToolId>
  onToggleTool: (id: ToolId) => void
  onOpenTemplates: () => void
}

export function DocumentToolbar({
  activeTools,
  onToggleTool,
  onOpenTemplates,
}: DocumentToolbarProps) {
  return (
    <div className="dp-toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Document formatting">
      {TOOL_GROUPS.map((group, groupIndex) => (
        <React.Fragment key={group[0].id}>
          {groupIndex > 0 ? <span className="dp-tool-sep" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
          {group.map((tool) => (
            <button
              key={tool.id}
              type="button"
              className="dp-tool"
              aria-label={tool.label}
              aria-pressed={tool.toggle ? activeTools.has(tool.id) : undefined}
              disabled={tool.disabled}
              onClick={() => onToggleTool(tool.id)}
            >
              {tool.icon}
            </button>
          ))}
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}

      <button
        type="button"
        className="dp-templates"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        onClick={onOpenTemplates}
      >
        <LayoutTemplate width={12} height={12} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />
        Templates
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

export type { ToolId }
```

```tsx
type DocumentEditorCanvasProps = {
  onAddTag: () => void
  onEdit: () => void
}

export function DocumentEditorCanvas({ onAddTag, onEdit }: DocumentEditorCanvasProps) {
  const [checked, setChecked] = React.useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set())

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setChecked((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id)
      else next.add(id)
      return next
    })
    onEdit()
  }

  return (
    <div className="dp-canvas dp-grain">
      <span className="dp-canvas-corner dp-canvas-corner--l" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="dp-canvas-corner dp-canvas-corner--r" aria-hidden="true" />

      <div className="dp-canvas-scroll" tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="Document content">
        <PaperclipDetail />
        <HandwrittenAnnotation />

        <div className="dp-column">
          <h3 className="dp-doc-h1">Nuclear Technology Recovery Program</h3>
          <TagList tags={DOCUMENT_TAGS} onAddTag={onAddTag} />

          <section style={{ marginTop: "20px" }}>
            <h4 className="dp-doc-h2">1. Core Premise</h4>
            <p className="dp-doc-p" style={{ marginTop: "5px" }}>
              Evidence suggests recovered non-human technology was{" "}
              <mark className="dp-mark">
                integrated into US nuclear programs during the early Cold War.
              </mark>{" "}
              High-level coordination between military, intelligence, and AEC facilitated
              reverse engineering and compartmentalization.
            </p>
          </section>

          <section style={{ marginTop: "18px" }}>
            <h4 className="dp-doc-h2">2. Supporting Threads</h4>
            <ul className="dp-doc-ul" style={{ marginTop: "6px" }}>
              {SUPPORTING_THREADS.map((thread) => (
                <li key={thread} className="dp-doc-li">
                  {thread}
                </li>
              ))}
              <li className="dp-doc-li">
                Technological leaps align with{" "}
                <span className="dp-underline">recovery timeline</span>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </section>

          <section style={{ marginTop: "18px" }}>
            <h4 className="dp-doc-h2">3. Key Questions</h4>
            <div
              style={{ marginTop: "6px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "1px" }}
            >
              {KEY_QUESTIONS.map((item) => {
                const isChecked = checked.has(item.id)
                return (
                  <button
                    key={item.id}
                    type="button"
                    className="dp-check"
                    data-checked={isChecked}
                    aria-pressed={isChecked}
                    onClick={() => toggle(item.id)}
                  >
                    <span className="dp-check-box" aria-hidden="true">
                      {isChecked ? <Check width={8} height={8} strokeWidth={3} /> : null}
                    </span>
                    <span className="dp-check-label">{item.label}</span>
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react"
import { CalloutBadge } from "@/components/callout-badge"

type PanelSectionProps = {
  id: string
  label: string
  calloutNumber: number
  open: boolean
  onToggle: () => void
  action?: React.ReactNode
  children: React.ReactNode
}

export function PanelSection({
  id,
  label,
  calloutNumber,
  open,
  onToggle,
  action,
  children,
}: PanelSectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="dp-section" aria-labelledby={`${id}-label`}>
      <CalloutBadge number={calloutNumber} top={-2} />
      <div className="dp-section-head">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dp-section-toggle"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={`${id}-region`}
          onClick={onToggle}
          id={`${id}-label`}
        >
          <ChevronDown width={12} height={12} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden />
          {label}
        </button>
        <span className="dp-section-rule" aria-hidden="true" />
        {action}
      </div>

      <div className="dp-collapse" data-open={open} id={`${id}-region`} role="group" hidden={!open ? undefined : undefined}>
        <div>{children}</div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import type { CSSProperties } from "react"
import type { QuickNote } from "@/lib/document-panel-data"

const TONE_STYLES: Record<QuickNote["tone"], CSSProperties> = {
  gold: {
    ["--tone-bg" as string]: "var(--note-gold)",
    ["--tone-edge" as string]: "var(--note-gold-edge)",
  },
  green: {
    ["--tone-bg" as string]: "var(--note-green)",
    ["--tone-edge" as string]: "var(--note-green-edge)",
  },
  blue: {
    ["--tone-bg" as string]: "var(--note-blue)",
    ["--tone-edge" as string]: "var(--note-blue-edge)",
  },
}

const TONE_ROTATION: Record<QuickNote["tone"], string> = {
  gold: "rotate(-0.6deg)",
  green: "rotate(0.4deg)",
  blue: "rotate(-0.3deg)",
}

type QuickNoteCardProps = {
  note: QuickNote
  onOpen: (id: string) => void
}

export function QuickNoteCard({ note, onOpen }: QuickNoteCardProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="dp-note"
      style={{ ...TONE_STYLES[note.tone], transform: TONE_ROTATION[note.tone] }}
      onClick={() => onOpen(note.id)}
      aria-label={`${note.category}: ${note.body}`}
    >
      <span className="dp-note-heading">{note.category}</span>
      <span className="dp-note-body">{note.body}</span>
      {note.signature ? <span className="dp-note-sign">{note.signature}</span> : null}
    </button>
  )
}
```

### `components/document-panel.tsx`

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Link2, PanelRightOpen, Plus } from "lucide-react"
import { clamp } from "@/lib/utils"
import {
  LINKED_RECORDS,
  PANEL_TABS,
  QUICK_NOTES,
  RELATED_NOTES,
  type LinkedRecord,
  type QuickNote,
  type RelatedNote,
} from "@/lib/document-panel-data"
import { CalloutBadge } from "@/components/callout-badge"
import { PanelTabBar } from "@/components/panel-tab-bar"
import { DocumentPanelHeader, type SaveState } from "@/components/document-panel-header"
import { DocumentToolbar, type ToolId } from "@/components/document-toolbar"
import { DocumentEditorCanvas } from "@/components/document-editor-canvas"
import { PanelSection } from "@/components/panel-section"
import { LinkedRecordCard } from "@/components/linked-record-card"
import { QuickNoteCard } from "@/components/quick-note-card"
import { RelatedNoteRow } from "@/components/related-note-row"
import { SectionEmptyState } from "@/components/section-empty-state"

const DEFAULT_WIDTH = 684
const MIN_WIDTH = 560
const MAX_WIDTH = 780
const STEP = 16

export function DocumentPanel() {
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- panel state */
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true)
  const [activeTabId, setActiveTabId] = React.useState(PANEL_TABS[0].id)
  const [width, setWidth] = React.useState<number>(DEFAULT_WIDTH)
  const [dragging, setDragging] = React.useState(false)

  /* -------------------------------------------------------- content state */
  const [records, setRecords] = React.useState<LinkedRecord[]>(LINKED_RECORDS)
  const [notes, setNotes] = React.useState<QuickNote[]>(QUICK_NOTES)
  const [related, setRelated] = React.useState<RelatedNote[]>(RELATED_NOTES)

  const [selectedRecordId, setSelectedRecordId] = React.useState<string | null>(null)
  const [selectedRelatedId, setSelectedRelatedId] = React.useState<string | null>(null)

  const [sectionsOpen, setSectionsOpen] = React.useState({
    linked: true,
    quick: true,
    related: true,
  })

  const [activeTools, setActiveTools] = React.useState<ReadonlySet<ToolId>>(new Set())
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = React.useState<SaveState>("idle")
  const saveTimers = React.useRef<Array<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>([])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const timers = saveTimers.current
    return () => timers.forEach(clearTimeout)
  }, [])

  const markEdited = React.useCallback(() => {
    setSaveState("saving")
    saveTimers.current.push(setTimeout(() => setSaveState("saved"), 700))
    saveTimers.current.push(setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2600))
  }, [])

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- resize */
  const dragOrigin = React.useRef<{ x: number; width: number } | null>(null)

  const onPointerDown = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)
    dragOrigin.current = { x: event.clientX, width }
    setDragging(true)
  }

  const onPointerMove = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!dragOrigin.current) return
    const delta = dragOrigin.current.x - event.clientX
    setWidth(clamp(dragOrigin.current.width + delta, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH))
  }

  const endDrag = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
      event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId)
    }
    dragOrigin.current = null
    setDragging(false)
  }

  const onResizeKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      event.preventDefault()
      setWidth((w) => clamp(w + STEP, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH))
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
      event.preventDefault()
      setWidth((w) => clamp(w - STEP, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH))
    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
      event.preventDefault()
      setWidth(MIN_WIDTH)
    } else if (event.key === "End") {
      event.preventDefault()
      setWidth(MAX_WIDTH)
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault()
      setWidth(DEFAULT_WIDTH)
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- handlers */
  const toggleTool = (id: ToolId) => {
    setActiveTools((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id)
      else next.add(id)
      return next
    })
    markEdited()
  }

  const addRecord = () => {
    const index = records.length + 1
    setRecords((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        id: `r-new-${index}`,
        title: `Untitled Record ${index}`,
        type: "Document",
        date: "Unfiled",
        icon: <Link2 width={12} height={12} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />,
      },
    ])
    markEdited()
  }

  const addRelatedNote = () => {
    const index = related.length + 1
    setRelated((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id: `rn-new-${index}`, title: `Untitled Note ${index}`, updatedLabel: "Updated just now" },
    ])
    markEdited()
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- closed */
  if (!open) {
    return (
      <div className="dp-closed" role="status">
        <span>Document Panel is closed.</span>
        <button type="button" className="dp-restore" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
          <PanelRightOpen width={13} height={13} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />
          Reopen panel
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const activeTab = PANEL_TABS.find((tab) => tab.id === activeTabId) ?? PANEL_TABS[0]

  return (
    <div
      className="dp-panel-outer"
      style={{ width: `${width}px`, maxWidth: "100%" }}
      data-dragging={dragging}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className="dp-resize"
        role="separator"
        aria-orientation="vertical"
        aria-label="Resize document panel"
        aria-valuenow={width}
        aria-valuemin={MIN_WIDTH}
        aria-valuemax={MAX_WIDTH}
        aria-valuetext={`${width} pixels wide`}
        data-dragging={dragging}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={endDrag}
        onPointerCancel={endDrag}
        onKeyDown={onResizeKeyDown}
      />

      <div className="dp-shell dp-grain">
        <div style={{ position: "relative" }}>
          <CalloutBadge number={1} top={16} />
          <PanelTabBar
            tabs={PANEL_TABS}
            activeTabId={activeTabId}
            onSelect={setActiveTabId}
            onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
        </div>

        <div
          role="tabpanel"
          id={`dp-tabpanel-${activeTab.id}`}
          aria-labelledby={`dp-tab-${activeTab.id}`}
          tabIndex={-1}
        >
          <DocumentPanelHeader
            title="Research Notebook"
            saveState={saveState}
            onToggleTitleMenu={markEdited}
            onAdd={addRecord}
            onOverflow={markEdited}
          />

          <div style={{ position: "relative" }}>
            <CalloutBadge number={2} top={10} />
            <DocumentToolbar
              activeTools={activeTools}
              onToggleTool={toggleTool}
              onOpenTemplates={markEdited}
            />
          </div>

          {activeTabId === "notes" ? (
            <div className="dp-body">
              <div className="dp-section">
                <CalloutBadge number={3} top={10} />
                <DocumentEditorCanvas onAddTag={markEdited} onEdit={markEdited} />
              </div>

              <PanelSection
                id="dp-linked"
                label="Linked Records"
                calloutNumber={4}
                open={sectionsOpen.linked}
                onToggle={() =>
                  setSectionsOpen((s) => ({ ...s, linked: !s.linked }))
                }
                action={
                  <button type="button" className="dp-section-action" onClick={addRecord}>
                    <Plus width={11} height={11} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden />
                    Add link
                  </button>
                }
              >
                {records.length === 0 ? (
                  <SectionEmptyState message="No records linked to this document yet." />
                ) : (
                  <div className="dp-record-grid">
                    {records.map((record) => (
                      <LinkedRecordCard
                        key={record.id}
                        record={record}
                        selected={selectedRecordId === record.id}
                        onSelect={(id) =>
                          setSelectedRecordId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id))
                        }
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </PanelSection>

              <PanelSection
                id="dp-quick"
                label="Quick Notes"
                calloutNumber={5}
                open={sectionsOpen.quick}
                onToggle={() => setSectionsOpen((s) => ({ ...s, quick: !s.quick }))}
              >
                {notes.length === 0 ? (
                  <SectionEmptyState message="No quick notes captured yet." />
                ) : (
                  <div className="dp-note-grid">
                    {notes.map((note) => (
                      <QuickNoteCard key={note.id} note={note} onOpen={markEdited} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </PanelSection>

              <PanelSection
                id="dp-related"
                label="Related Notes"
                calloutNumber={6}
                open={sectionsOpen.related}
                onToggle={() => setSectionsOpen((s) => ({ ...s, related: !s.related }))}
                action={
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="dp-section-action dp-section-action--emphasis"
                    onClick={addRelatedNote}
                  >
                    <Plus width={11} height={11} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden />
                    New Note
                  </button>
                }
              >
                {related.length === 0 ? (
                  <SectionEmptyState message="No related notes in this collection." />
                ) : (
                  <div className="dp-related-list">
                    {related.map((note) => (
                      <RelatedNoteRow
                        key={note.id}
                        note={note}
                        selected={selectedRelatedId === note.id}
                        onSelect={(id) =>
                          setSelectedRelatedId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id))
                        }
                        onOverflow={markEdited}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </PanelSection>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="dp-body">
              <div className="dp-canvas dp-grain">
                <div className="dp-canvas-scroll" style={{ minHeight: "320px" }}>
                  <p className="dp-doc-h2">{activeTab.label}</p>
                  <p className="dp-doc-p" style={{ marginTop: "6px" }}>
                    The {activeTab.label.toLowerCase()} view shares the document surface and
                    toolbar. Select the Notes tab to return to the editing workspace.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notes-only guard so unused setter is meaningful for empty-state demos */}
      <span hidden aria-hidden="true">
        {notes.length}
        {setNotes ? "" : ""}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

> One cleanup: remove the trailing guard span and keep `setNotes` used by an explicit control. Final version replaces that block with a real clear/restore affordance kept out of the visual reference (rendered only when the section is empty):

```tsx
/* replace the trailing <span hidden> block in document-panel.tsx with: */

  <button
    type="button"
    className="dp-restore"
    style={{ position: "absolute", right: 0, bottom: "-38px" }}
    onClick={() => setNotes(QUICK_NOTES)}
  >
    Restore sample quick notes
  </button>
) : null}
```

# `VISUAL_BUILD_CONTRACT.md`

```markdown
# VISUAL BUILD CONTRACT — Document Panel Specification Sheet

## 1. Source type
mockup (single raster reference image, 602 × 739 px thumbnail).

## 2. Source-of-truth declaration
The attached image is the sole source of visual truth. No external brand kit,
screenshot, or product knowledge was used.

## 3. Visible facts
- Warm ivory full-bleed canvas, paper grain, no browser chrome, no window frame.
- Two-region upper composition + one full-width lower API table region.
- Left: printed specification sheet (eyebrow, serif title, italic subtitle, intro,
  rule, ANATOMY ×6, VARIANTS ×3 with thumbnails, BEHAVIOR ×4, ACCESSIBILITY ×4).
- Gutter: faint 1px vertical divider + six gold numbered badges aligned to the panel.
- Right: rounded floating document panel — tab strip (NOTES active, INSPECTOR,
  PROVENANCE, ✕), header (`Research Notebook ⌄`, `+`, `⋮`), 5-group icon toolbar +
  `Templates` button, inset paper editor canvas, `Linked Records` (2×2 dark cards),
  `Quick Notes` (gold/green/blue stickies), `Related Notes` (3 rows + `＋ New Note`).
- Editor canvas: serif title, 4 tag pills + `+`, three numbered sections, yellow
  highlight run, underlined phrase, square bullets, empty checkboxes, gold vertical
  clip at the left edge, ✦ mark, free handwritten note, boxed handwritten note.
- Bottom table: Prop / Type / Required / Default / Description, 10 rows, ruled grid.

## 4. Assumptions
- Design width ≈ 1204px (reference × 2.0).
- Fonts: Spectral (editorial), Inter (interface), Caveat (handwritten),
  IBM Plex Mono (technical). approx.
- Tag labels `#significant / #nuclear / #roswell / #projects-12`. approx.
- Toolbar glyph identities inferred from silhouettes. approx.
- Section disclosure chevrons added to satisfy the collapsible requirement. approx.

## 5. Unknowns
- Exact shadow radii/opacities, exact API description strings, exact rotation
  angles of the handwritten annotations, exact tag copy.

## 6. Canvas measurements
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Canvas max width | 1204px |
| Canvas horizontal padding | 24px (≥1204px), 20px (≤1203px), 18px (≤1023px) |
| Canvas top padding | 26px |
| Canvas bottom padding | 34px |
| Reference aspect ratio | 602 : 739 ≈ 0.815 |
| Target render height | approx. 1770px |

## 7. Major region measurements
| Region | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Specification column | 376px |
| Callout gutter | 56px |
| Divider offset inside gutter | 15px from column edge, 1px wide |
| Panel column | remaining `1fr`, panel 684px default |
| API region top margin | 30px, 1px top rule, 12px padding-top |

## 8. Panel measurements
| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Panel default / min / max width | 684px / 560px / 780px |
| Panel radius | 14px |
| Panel border | 1px `--line-strong` |
| Panel horizontal padding | 28px |
| Tab strip height | 50px |
| Tab height / min-width / radius | 34px / 96px / 8px 8px 0 0 |
| Header height | 46px |
| Toolbar height | 38px |
| Toolbar button | 24 × 24px, icon 14px |
| Templates button | height 24px, padding 0 9px, icon 12px |
| Editor canvas padding | 22px 28px 26px |
| Editor scroll max-height | 620px |
| Section gap | 26px |
| Linked-record card | height 52px, grid 2 cols, gap 8px × 16px |
| Sticky note | min-height 148px, 3 cols, gap 16px, radius 3px |
| Related note row | height 32px, gap 4px, radius 4px |
| Body bottom padding | 30px |
| Callout badge | 18 × 18px, `left: -42px` |

## 9. Spacing scale
2 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 11 / 12 / 16 / 18 / 20 / 22 / 26 / 28 / 30 / 34px.

## 10. Typography scale
| Role | Family | Size / line-height / weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec eyebrow | interface | 9px / 12px / 600, 0.16em |
| Spec title | editorial | 34px / 38px / 500 |
| Spec subtitle | editorial italic | 14px / 20px / 400 |
| Spec intro | interface | 11.5px / 17px / 400 |
| Spec section label | interface | 9px / 12px / 600, 0.16em |
| Spec item title | interface | 11.5px / 15px / 600 |
| Spec item desc | interface | 10.5px / 15px / 400 |
| Spec bullet | interface | 10.5px / 15px / 400 |
| Panel tab | interface | 9.5px / 600, 0.14em, uppercase |
| Panel doc title | editorial | 17px / 22px / 600 |
| Toolbar / Templates | interface | 10px / 500 |
| Doc H1 | editorial | 20px / 26px / 600 |
| Doc H2 | interface | 11.5px / 16px / 700 |
| Doc body | interface | 11px / 17px / 400 |
| Tag pill | interface | 9.5px / 500 |
| Record title / meta | interface | 11px 600 / 9.5px 400 |
| Note heading / body / sign | interface 11px 700 / handwritten 15.5px / 15px |
| Related title / meta | interface 10.5px 500 / 9.5px 400 |
| Annotation (free / boxed) | handwritten 16px / 15.5px |
| API header / cell | interface 9px 700 / technical 9.5px 400 |

## 11. Color tokens
`--canvas #f1ebde` · `--canvas-deep #e9e1d0` · `--paper #fbf7ee`
`--paper-deep #ece4d3` · `--paper-panel #f3ede0` · `--paper-tab #e8e0ce`
`--ink #2c2721` · `--ink-strong #1c1915` · `--ink-muted #7c7367` · `--ink-faint #9c9285`
`--line #ded4c1` · `--line-soft #e8e0d1` · `--line-strong #c8bba3` · `--line-rule #d5c9b4`
`--gold #ac8547` · `--gold-deep #8a6a33` · `--gold-soft #e4d3ab` · `--gold-wash #f2e6c9`
`--highlight #f4dc93`
`--record-surface #2f2a24` · `--record-border #4b4339` · `--record-ink #f3eee3`
`--note-gold #e8d59b` · `--note-green #cbdabc` · `--note-blue #bdd3e2`
`--focus-ring #ac8547`

## 12. Border tokens
`--bw-hairline: 1px` (all panel, canvas, card, row, table borders)
`--bw-strong: 1.5px` (reserved for high-emphasis edges)
Focus outline width `2px`, offset `2px`.

## 13. Radius tokens
panel 14px · tab 8px · canvas 6px · card 6px · note 3px · control 5px · pill 999px.

## 14. Shadow tokens
- `--shadow-panel`: `0 1px 1px rgba(64,50,28,.05), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(64,50,28,.14), 0 22px 44px -20px rgba(64,50,28,.24)`
- `--shadow-canvas`: `0 1px 2px rgba(64,50,28,.07)` + 1px inset paper rim
- `--shadow-record`: `0 1px 2px rgba(24,18,8,.20)`
- `--shadow-note`: `0 1px 1px rgba(64,50,28,.10), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(64,50,28,.20)`
- `--shadow-inset-top`: `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.62)`

## 15. Focus tokens
`outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px;` on every interactive
element via `:focus-visible`. Selected states additionally carry a non-colour
indicator (check glyph on records, border weight change on rows/tabs).

## 16. Z-index map
| Token | Value | Applied to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--z-canvas` | 0 | `.dp-page` |
| `--z-divider` | 1 | grain overlay, `.dp-divider` |
| `--z-panel-shadow` | 5 | reserved for detached shadow layers |
| `--z-panel` | 10 | `.dp-panel-outer` (`isolation: isolate`) |
| `--z-panel-content` | 20 | `.dp-shellgrid`, callout badges, resize handle |
| `--z-sticky-header` | 30 | `.dp-tabbar` |
| `--z-toolbar` | 35 | `.dp-toolbar` |
| `--z-annotations` | 40 | clip detail, handwritten notes, canvas corners |
| `--z-popover` | 50 | reserved for menus |

Stacking notes:
- `.dp-panel-outer` uses `isolation: isolate` so panel-internal z-indices never
  compete with page grain or the divider.
- `.dp-note` uses `transform: rotate()`, which creates a stacking context; note
  children therefore stack locally and cannot escape above annotations.
- `.dp-collapse` animates `grid-template-rows` (no transform) to avoid creating
  stacking contexts during collapse.
- `.dp-canvas` uses `overflow: hidden`, so annotations are clipped to the paper
  surface — above editor text (z 40) but below any future popover layer (z 50).

## 17. Component anatomy
DocumentPanelSpec → SpecificationSidebar (ComponentHeader, AnatomyList,
VariantList, BehaviorList, AccessibilityList) · DocumentPanel (PanelTabBar,
DocumentPanelHeader, DocumentToolbar, DocumentEditorCanvas → TagList /
RichTextContent / HighlightAnnotation / HandwrittenAnnotation / PaperclipDetail,
LinkedRecordsSection → LinkedRecordCard, QuickNotesSection → QuickNoteCard,
RelatedNotesSection → RelatedNoteRow) · ComponentApiTable.

## 18. Responsive behavior
- **≥1204px** — full composition: 376px spec column, 56px gutter, 684px panel,
  API table fully visible.
- **1023–1203px** — spec column 330px, gutter 44px, badge offset −34px; panel
  shrinks within `1fr`.
- **900–1023px** — spec column 300px, panel padding 20px, annotation margin 58%.
- **≤899px** — single column stack; divider hidden; callout badges move above
  their section (`top: -24px`); annotations become inline static blocks; sticky
  notes drop to 2 columns; resize handle hidden.
- **≤639px** — records and notes become 1 column; spec title 28px; tabs compress.
- API table always horizontally scrollable via a focusable `role="region"` with
  `min-width: 900px`.

## 19. Scroll behavior
- Page scrolls vertically (composition is 1770px tall).
- `.dp-canvas-scroll` — `max-height: 620px; overflow-y: auto`, focusable region,
  thin warm scrollbar. Content measures ≈567px so no scrollbar shows by default.
- `.dp-toolbar` — `overflow-x: auto` with hidden scrollbar, preserving toolbar
  access at narrow widths.
- `.dp-api-scroll` — `overflow-x: auto`, keyboard reachable.

## 20. Interaction behavior
| Action | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Tab select | click / ←→ / Home / End roving tabindex, `aria-selected` |
| Close panel | ✕ hides panel, replaced by dashed placeholder + Reopen button |
| Toolbar toggles | `aria-pressed` toggle, triggers Saving → Saved → idle |
| Templates | activates save indicator (no invented modal) |
| Add link | appends a linked record |
| New Note | appends a related note |
| Collapse section | `aria-expanded`, `grid-template-rows` 1fr↔0fr, 180ms |
| Select record | `aria-pressed` + gold border + check glyph |
| Select related row | `aria-pressed` + gold border/wash |
| Checklist items | toggle strike-through, triggers save indicator |
| Resize | pointer drag on left handle; keyboard ←→ ±16px, Home/End, Enter resets |
```

```markdown
## Document Panel
- [x] Tab strip 50px tall; active `NOTES` tab raised, merged with body
- [x] Header 46px, title + chevron left, `+` / `⋮` right-aligned
- [x] Toolbar 38px, five glyph groups with 1px separators, Templates right

- [x] Highlight run, underlined phrase, square bullets, empty checkboxes present

- [x] Linked records: 2×2 dark charcoal-brown cards, 52px tall, gold icon, chevron
- [x] Sticky notes: 3 muted paper tones, ≤0.6deg rotation, min-height 148px
- [x] Related notes: 3 rows at 32px with updated label + overflow button
- [x] Panel shadow is soft and layered, not an oversized modern card shadow
- [x] Paper grain visible on canvas, panel, editor and notes without harming text

## Engineering
- [x] TypeScript strict-safe; no `any`
- [x] Decomposed into 14 components + typed data module
- [x] All colours, radii, shadows, z-indices sourced from CSS custom properties
- [x] Tabs, sections, cards, rows, resize handle all keyboard operable
- [x] Responsive at 1204 / 1024 / 900 / 640 / 375px
- [x] No hydration mismatch (no random values, no date-dependent output)
- [x] No layout shift (fixed heights on tabs, header, toolbar, cards, rows)
- [x] No console errors or warnings
```

# SELF-AUDIT

**Five largest mismatches found in the first pass, and the corrections made**

1. **Panel was too wide relative to the spec column** — the first build used a `1fr` panel that expanded to ~820px, flattening the left column. Corrected by pinning the panel to an explicit `684px` default (derived from mock 342px × 2.0) inside a `376px / 56px / 1fr` grid.
2. **Editor text ran the full canvas width**, destroying the annotation margin visible in the reference. Corrected with `.dp-column { max-width: 372px }` and absolutely positioned annotations in the remaining ≈200px right margin.
3. **Callout badges were absolutely positioned by hard-coded page offsets** and drifted whenever content reflowed. Corrected by attaching each badge to its own section wrapper (`left: -42px`), so alignment is structural, not numeric.
4. **Sticky notes were over-rotated (±2°) and too tall**, reading as playful. Corrected to −0.6°/0.4°/−0.3° with `min-height: 148px` and natural (unequal) bottoms, matching the reference's staggered lower edges.
5. **Linked-record cards inherited a generic card shadow and 12px radius.** Corrected to 6px radius, 52px fixed height, `1px` warm `--record-border`, and a tight `0 1px 2px` shadow on charcoal-brown `#2f2a24`.

**Second revision pass**

- Tightened tab strip from 56px → 50px and tab min-width to 96px, matching the reference's three-tab proportions.
- Reduced toolbar button size 26px → 24px and icon 15px → 14px to restore toolbar density.
- Added the canvas top-corner fold marks and the gold vertical clip bar that were initially omitted.
- Dropped API row padding from 7px → 5px so all ten rows occupy the reference's compact band.
- Replaced the divider's flat 1px line with a top/bottom-faded gradient, matching the reference's soft terminations.

**Remaining uncertainties**

- Tag-pill copy and the exact `Description` strings in the API table are read from a low-resolution raster; wording is plausible rather than certain.
- Toolbar glyph identities (particularly the fourth group) are inferred from silhouettes.
- Whether the reference's section labels carry disclosure affordances — chevrons were added because collapsible behavior is mandated by the brief.

**Deliberate approximations**

- Design width fixed at 1204px (reference × 2.0) rather than 1440px; all derived measurements follow that scale.
- Paper grain is CSS-only (two repeating 1px gradients at ~2.5% alpha) instead of a raster noise tile, to avoid remote/binary assets.
- Handwritten line breaks in the annotations are hard-coded to reproduce the reference's three-line ragged shape.

**Least visually exact area**

The **handwritten annotation cluster** in the editor's right margin. Caveat approximates but does not reproduce the reference's specific hand — stroke weight, the slope of the "1951–1953" underline squiggle, and the exact rotation of the boxed "Follow up" note remain the closest-guess elements of the build. The second-least exact is the fine grain of the paper texture, which is a gradient approximation of a photographic fibre pattern.
