.dp-tabbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-sticky-header);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 50px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
  border-radius: calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) 0 0;
  background: var(--paper-tab);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset-top);
}

.dp-tab {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  min-width: 96px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-tab) var(--r-tab) 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tab:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.5);
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected=&#34;true&#34;] {
  background: var(--paper-panel);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset;
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected=&#34;true&#34;]::after {
  content: &#34;&#34;;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--paper-panel);
}

.dp-tabclose {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.dp-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.dp-doc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.004em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-savestate {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-toolbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-toolbar);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.55), rgba(255, 253, 246, 0));
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.dp-toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.dp-tool {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  color: #625a4f;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tool:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-tool:active {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.dp-tool[aria-pressed=&#34;true&#34;] {
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tool:disabled {
  opacity: 0.38;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.dp-tool-sep {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 1px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0 5px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-templates {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #5b5348;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) inset;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-templates:hover {
  background: #fffdf6;
}

.dp-body {
  padding: 16px var(--panel-pad-x) 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--panel-section-gap);
}

.dp-canvas {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-canvas);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-canvas);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dp-canvas-scroll {
  position: relative;
  max-height: 620px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 22px 28px 26px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--paper);
}

.dp-canvas-corner {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
}
.dp-canvas-corner--l {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
}
.dp-canvas-corner--r {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(225deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
}

.dp-doc-h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 26px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.008em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-column {
  max-width: 372px;
}

.dp-tagrow {
  margin-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.dp-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 19px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #f4efe3;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: #5f574c;
}
.dp-tag--gold {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tag-add {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-tag-add:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-doc-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-doc-p {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: #4f483e;
}

.dp-mark {
  background: var(--highlight);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  margin: 0 -2px;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}

.dp-underline {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #8b8272;
  padding-bottom: 0.5px;
}

.dp-doc-ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-doc-li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-doc-li::before {
  content: &#34;&#34;;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 6px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 0.5px;
}

.dp-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 1.5px 0;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-check-box {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 2px;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #fffdf7;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-check[data-checked=&#34;true&#34;] .dp-check-box {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-check[data-checked=&#34;true&#34;] .dp-check-label {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-clip {
  position: absolute;
  left: 13px;
  width: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d8b878, var(--gold));
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.28), inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-clip-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 14px;
  color: var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(28deg);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.3));
}

.dp-annotation {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  color: #4a4235;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-hand-1 {
  top: 44px;
  right: 6px;
  width: 132px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-2.2deg);
}
.dp-hand-squiggle {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1px;
  width: 82px;
  height: 5px;
  color: #6d6353;
}
.dp-hand-star {
  top: 178px;
  right: 148px;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  transform: rotate(6deg);
}
.dp-hand-box {
  top: 300px;
  right: 8px;
  width: 142px;
  padding: 9px 11px 11px;
  border: 1px solid #a9bcc9;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(228, 238, 244, 0.5);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-1.6deg);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.08);
}

.dp-section {
  position: relative;
}

.dp-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.dp-section-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 2px 2px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-toggle svg {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-toggle[aria-expanded=&#34;false&#34;] svg {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.dp-section-rule {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-section-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6b6357;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-action:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis:hover {
  background: #f7ecd4;
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-collapse {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows var(--dur-base) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-collapse[data-open=&#34;false&#34;] {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
}
.dp-collapse &gt; div {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}

.dp-empty {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.42);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-record-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px 16px;
}

.dp-record {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--record-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: var(--record-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-record:hover {
  background: var(--record-surface-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.dp-record[data-selected=&#34;true&#34;] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--record-surface-active);
}
.dp-record-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.35);
  background: rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.14);
  color: #d3ad69;
}
.dp-record-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--record-ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-meta {
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 13px;
  color: var(--record-ink-muted);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-check {
  margin-left: 4px;
  color: var(--gold);
}

.dp-note-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}

.dp-note {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  min-height: 148px;
  padding: 11px 12px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-note);
  border: 1px solid var(--tone-edge);
  background: var(--tone-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-note:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1.5px);
}
.dp-note::before {
  content: &#34;&#34;;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 34%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(90, 72, 40, 0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
}
.dp-note-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #3a332a;
}
.dp-note-body {
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  color: #3f382d;
}
.dp-note-sign {
  margin-top: auto;
  align-self: flex-end;
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #4c4436;
}

.dp-related-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-related-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 8px 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.72);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-related-row:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}
.dp-related-row[data-selected=&#34;true&#34;] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-related-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-related-meta {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-iconbtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  color: #625a4f;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-iconbtn:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: transparent;
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost:hover {
  border-color: var(--line);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.85);
}
.dp-iconbtn--dim {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-titlebtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 4px 2px 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-titlebtn:hover .dp-doc-title {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-page :where(button, [role=&#34;tab&#34;], [role=&#34;separator&#34;], a, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
}

.dp-resize {
  position: absolute;
  top: 60px;
  bottom: 60px;
  left: -13px;
  width: 12px;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: col-resize;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  touch-action: none;
}
.dp-resize::after {
  content: &#34;&#34;;
  width: 3px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-resize:hover::after,
.dp-resize:focus-visible::after,
.dp-resize[data-dragging=&#34;true&#34;]::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.dp-closed {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 300px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-panel);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.4);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-restore {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.dp-api {
  margin-top: 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line-rule);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.dp-api-label {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dp-api-scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.55);
}

.dp-api-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 900px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: var(--font-technical);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 14px;
}
.dp-api-table thead th {
  text-align: left;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-api-table thead th:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  color: #564f45;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(236, 228, 211, 0.28);
}
.dp-api-prop {
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.dp-api-req {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dp-col-prop { width: 170px; }
.dp-col-type { width: 190px; }
.dp-col-req { width: 110px; }
.dp-col-def { width: 120px; }

.dp-route-shell {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 80;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f1ebde;
}

.dp-route-shell ~ * {
  /* noop anchor */
}

body:has(.dp-page) main.site {
  background-color: #f1ebde !important;
}

body:has(.dp-page) [data-menu-trigger],
body:has(.dp-page) .menu-trigger {
  display: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 1203px) {
  .dp-page {
    --canvas-pad-x: 20px;
    --col-spec: 330px;
    --col-gutter: 44px;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: -34px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .dp-page {
    --canvas-pad-x: 18px;
    --col-spec: 300px;
    --col-gutter: 40px;
    --panel-pad-x: 20px;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 58%;
  }
  .dp-hand-1,
  .dp-hand-box {
    width: 118px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .dp-top {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    row-gap: 30px;
  }
  .dp-divider {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: 0;
    top: -24px;
  }
  .dp-panel-outer {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-resize {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-annotation {
    position: static;
    display: block;
    width: auto;
    transform: none;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
  .dp-hand-star {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .dp-record-grid,
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .spec-title {
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 32px;
  }
  .dp-tab {
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 12px;
    font-size: 9px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dp-page *,
  .dp-page *::before,
  .dp-page *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .dp-collapse {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .dp-shell,
  .dp-canvas,
  .dp-record,
  .dp-note,
  .dp-related-row,
  .dp-api-scroll {
    border: 1px solid CanvasText;
  }
  .dp-tab[aria-selected=&#34;true&#34;] {
    border: 1px solid Highlight;
  }
  .dp-page::before,
  .dp-grain::after,
  .dp-note::before {
    display: none;
  }
}

from pathlib import Path
css = r'''/* =========================================================================
   DOCUMENT PANEL — SEMANTIC DESIGN TOKENS
   ========================================================================= */

.dp-page {
  --font-editorial: var(--font-editorial-src), "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype",
    Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-interface: var(--font-interface-src), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,
    "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-handwritten: var(--font-handwritten-src), "Segoe Script", "Bradley Hand",
    cursive;
  --font-technical: var(--font-technical-src), ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular",
    "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, monospace;

  --canvas: #f1ebde;
  --canvas-deep: #e9e1d0;
  --paper: #fbf7ee;
  --paper-deep: #ece4d3;
  --paper-panel: #f3ede0;
  --paper-tab: #e8e0ce;

  --ink: #2c2721;
  --ink-strong: #1c1915;
  --ink-muted: #7c7367;
  --ink-faint: #9c9285;

  --line: #ded4c1;
  --line-soft: #e8e0d1;
  --line-strong: #c8bba3;
  --line-rule: #d5c9b4;

  --gold: #ac8547;
  --gold-deep: #8a6a33;
  --gold-soft: #e4d3ab;
  --gold-wash: #f2e6c9;
  --highlight: #f4dc93;

  --record-surface: #2f2a24;
  --record-surface-hover: #3a342c;
  --record-surface-active: #453d33;
  --record-border: #4b4339;
  --record-ink: #f3eee3;
  --record-ink-muted: #a79d8e;

  --note-gold: #e8d59b;
  --note-gold-edge: #d3bd7d;
  --note-green: #cbdabc;
  --note-green-edge: #b3c6a1;
  --note-blue: #bdd3e2;
  --note-blue-edge: #a3bed1;

  --focus-ring: #ac8547;

  --canvas-max: 1204px;
  --canvas-pad-x: 24px;
  --canvas-pad-top: 26px;
  --canvas-pad-bottom: 34px;

  --col-spec: 376px;
  --col-gutter: 56px;

  --panel-width: 684px;
  --panel-min-width: 560px;
  --panel-max-width: 780px;
  --panel-pad-x: 28px;
  --panel-section-gap: 26px;

  --r-panel: 14px;
  --r-tab: 8px;
  --r-canvas: 6px;
  --r-card: 6px;
  --r-note: 3px;
  --r-control: 5px;
  --r-pill: 999px;

  --bw-hairline: 1px;
  --bw-strong: 1.5px;

  --shadow-panel: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.05), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.14),
    0 22px 44px -20px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.24);
  --shadow-panel-hover: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.06),
    0 8px 18px -6px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.16), 0 28px 52px -20px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.28);
  --shadow-canvas: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.07), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.7) inset;
  --shadow-record: 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 18, 8, 0.2);
  --shadow-record-hover: 0 2px 5px rgba(24, 18, 8, 0.26);
  --shadow-note: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.1), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.2);
  --shadow-note-hover: 0 2px 3px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.12), 0 7px 14px -5px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.24);
  --shadow-inset-top: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);

  --focus-width: 2px;
  --focus-offset: 2px;

  --z-canvas: 0;
  --z-divider: 1;
  --z-panel-shadow: 5;
  --z-panel: 10;
  --z-panel-content: 20;
  --z-sticky-header: 30;
  --z-toolbar: 35;
  --z-annotations: 40;
  --z-popover: 50;

  --dur-fast: 120ms;
  --dur-base: 180ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0.3, 1);

  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-canvas);
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  background-color: var(--canvas);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 0%, rgba(255, 252, 244, 0.9), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(100% 60% at 8% 100%, rgba(196, 176, 141, 0.16), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(100% 60% at 92% 88%, rgba(196, 176, 141, 0.13), transparent 60%);
}

.dp-page *,
.dp-page *::before,
.dp-page *::after {
  border-color: var(--line);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.dp-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-divider);
  opacity: 0.5;
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.032) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.024) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(37deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.016) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px);
}

.dp-grain {
  position: relative;
}
.dp-grain::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.55;
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.026) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120, 98, 62, 0.02) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px);
}

.dp-shellgrid {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--canvas-max);
  padding: var(--canvas-pad-top) var(--canvas-pad-x) var(--canvas-pad-bottom);
}

.dp-top {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--col-spec) var(--col-gutter) minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  column-gap: 0;
}

.dp-divider {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-divider);
  justify-self: start;
  margin-left: 15px;
  width: 1px;
  min-height: 100%;
  align-self: stretch;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent 0,
    var(--line) 14px,
    var(--line) calc(100% - 40px),
    transparent 100%
  );
}

.spec-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.spec-title {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 34px;
  line-height: 38px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.012em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.spec-subtitle {
  margin-top: 5px;
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: #6f6659;
}

.spec-intro {
  margin-top: 15px;
  max-width: 340px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: #5f574c;
}

.spec-rule {
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  height: 1px;
  width: 340px;
  max-width: 100%;
  background: var(--line-rule);
  border: 0;
}

.spec-section-label {
  margin-top: 20px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.spec-list {
  margin-top: 11px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 11px;
  max-width: 340px;
}

.spec-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: 10px;
  align-items: start;
}

.spec-item-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.spec-item-desc {
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 15px;
  color: #6c6458;
}

.spec-number {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  background: var(--gold);
  color: #fdf9f0;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
}

.spec-thumb {
  width: 40px;
  height: 30px;
  flex: 0 0 40px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 3px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.08);
}
.spec-thumb-bar {
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: var(--gold-soft);
}
.spec-thumb-block {
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: #ded5c3;
}
.spec-thumb-line {
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: #ded5c3;
}

.spec-bullets {
  margin-top: 11px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  max-width: 340px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}
.spec-bullet {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 13px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 15px;
  color: #5f574c;
}
.spec-bullet::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 6px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--gold);
}

.dp-callout {
  position: absolute;
  left: -42px;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  background: var(--gold);
  color: #fdf9f0;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dp-panel-col {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.dp-panel-outer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-panel);
  isolation: isolate;
}

.dp-shell {
  position: relative;
  border: var(--bw-hairline) solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-panel);
  background: var(--paper-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel), var(--shadow-inset-top);
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-shell:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel-hover), var(--shadow-inset-top);
}

.dp-tabbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-sticky-header);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 50px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
  border-radius: calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) calc(var(--r-panel) - 1px) 0 0;
  background: var(--paper-tab);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset-top);
}

.dp-tab {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  min-width: 96px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-tab) var(--r-tab) 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tab:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.5);
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--paper-panel);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset;
}
.dp-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--paper-panel);
}

.dp-tabclose {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.dp-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.dp-doc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.004em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-savestate {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-toolbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-toolbar);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 var(--panel-pad-x);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.55), rgba(255, 253, 246, 0));
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.dp-toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.dp-tool {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  color: #625a4f;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-tool:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-tool:active {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.dp-tool[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tool:disabled {
  opacity: 0.38;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.dp-tool-sep {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 1px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0 5px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-templates {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #5b5348;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) inset;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-templates:hover {
  background: #fffdf6;
}

.dp-body {
  padding: 16px var(--panel-pad-x) 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--panel-section-gap);
}

.dp-canvas {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-canvas);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-canvas);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dp-canvas-scroll {
  position: relative;
  max-height: 620px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 22px 28px 26px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}
.dp-canvas-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--paper);
}

.dp-canvas-corner {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
}
.dp-canvas-corner--l {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
}
.dp-canvas-corner--r {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(225deg, var(--paper-panel) 0 49%, transparent 50%);
}

.dp-doc-h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-editorial);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 26px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.008em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-column {
  max-width: 372px;
}

.dp-tagrow {
  margin-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.dp-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 19px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #f4efe3;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: #5f574c;
}
.dp-tag--gold {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-tag-add {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-tag-add:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-doc-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}

.dp-doc-p {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: #4f483e;
}

.dp-mark {
  background: var(--highlight);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  margin: 0 -2px;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}

.dp-underline {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #8b8272;
  padding-bottom: 0.5px;
}

.dp-doc-ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-doc-li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-doc-li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 6px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 0.5px;
}

.dp-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 1.5px 0;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #4f483e;
}
.dp-check-box {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 2px;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #fffdf7;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-check[data-checked="true"] .dp-check-box {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-check[data-checked="true"] .dp-check-label {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-clip {
  position: absolute;
  left: 13px;
  width: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d8b878, var(--gold));
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.28), inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-clip-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 14px;
  color: var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(28deg);
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.3));
}

.dp-annotation {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--z-annotations);
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  color: #4a4235;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dp-hand-1 {
  top: 44px;
  right: 6px;
  width: 132px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-2.2deg);
}
.dp-hand-squiggle {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1px;
  width: 82px;
  height: 5px;
  color: #6d6353;
}
.dp-hand-star {
  top: 178px;
  right: 148px;
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  transform: rotate(6deg);
}
.dp-hand-box {
  top: 300px;
  right: 8px;
  width: 142px;
  padding: 9px 11px 11px;
  border: 1px solid #a9bcc9;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(228, 238, 244, 0.5);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  transform: rotate(-1.6deg);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(64, 50, 28, 0.08);
}

.dp-section {
  position: relative;
}

.dp-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.dp-section-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 2px 2px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-toggle svg {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-toggle[aria-expanded="false"] svg {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.dp-section-rule {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.dp-section-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6b6357;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-section-action:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.9);
  border-color: var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis {
  border-color: var(--gold-soft);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}
.dp-section-action--emphasis:hover {
  background: #f7ecd4;
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-collapse {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows var(--dur-base) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-collapse[data-open="false"] {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
}
.dp-collapse > div {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}

.dp-empty {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.42);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-record-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px 16px;
}

.dp-record {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--record-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: var(--record-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-record:hover {
  background: var(--record-surface-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-record-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.dp-record[data-selected="true"] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--record-surface-active);
}
.dp-record-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.35);
  background: rgba(172, 133, 71, 0.14);
  color: #d3ad69;
}
.dp-record-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--record-ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-meta {
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 13px;
  color: var(--record-ink-muted);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-record-check {
  margin-left: 4px;
  color: var(--gold);
}

.dp-note-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}

.dp-note {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  min-height: 148px;
  padding: 11px 12px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-note);
  border: 1px solid var(--tone-edge);
  background: var(--tone-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease);
}
.dp-note:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-note-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1.5px);
}
.dp-note::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 34%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(90, 72, 40, 0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
}
.dp-note-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #3a332a;
}
.dp-note-body {
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 19px;
  color: #3f382d;
}
.dp-note-sign {
  margin-top: auto;
  align-self: flex-end;
  font-family: var(--font-handwritten);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #4c4436;
}

.dp-related-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dp-related-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 8px 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.72);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-related-row:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}
.dp-related-row[data-selected="true"] {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
}
.dp-related-title {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-related-meta {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.dp-iconbtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--paper);
  color: #625a4f;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease),
    border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-iconbtn:hover {
  background: #fffdf7;
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink-strong);
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: transparent;
}
.dp-iconbtn--ghost:hover {
  border-color: var(--line);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.85);
}
.dp-iconbtn--dim {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-titlebtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 4px 2px 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dp-titlebtn:hover .dp-doc-title {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
}

.dp-page :where(button, [role="tab"], [role="separator"], a, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
}

.dp-resize {
  position: absolute;
  top: 60px;
  bottom: 60px;
  left: -13px;
  width: 12px;
  z-index: var(--z-panel-content);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: col-resize;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  touch-action: none;
}
.dp-resize::after {
  content: "";
  width: 3px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
}
.dp-resize:hover::after,
.dp-resize:focus-visible::after,
.dp-resize[data-dragging="true"]::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.dp-closed {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 300px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-panel);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.4);
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dp-restore {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft);
  border-radius: var(--r-control);
  background: var(--gold-wash);
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.dp-api {
  margin-top: 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line-rule);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.dp-api-label {
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dp-api-scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.55);
}

.dp-api-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 900px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: var(--font-technical);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 14px;
}
.dp-api-table thead th {
  text-align: left;
  font-family: var(--font-interface);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dp-api-table thead th:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  color: #564f45;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.dp-api-table tbody td:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.dp-api-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(236, 228, 211, 0.28);
}
.dp-api-prop {
  color: var(--ink-strong);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.dp-api-req {
  color: var(--gold-deep);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dp-col-prop { width: 170px; }
.dp-col-type { width: 190px; }
.dp-col-req { width: 110px; }
.dp-col-def { width: 120px; }

.dp-route-shell {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 80;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f1ebde;
}

.dp-route-shell ~ * {
  /* noop anchor */
}

body:has(.dp-page) main.site {
  background-color: #f1ebde !important;
}

body:has(.dp-page) [data-menu-trigger],
body:has(.dp-page) .menu-trigger {
  display: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 1203px) {
  .dp-page {
    --canvas-pad-x: 20px;
    --col-spec: 330px;
    --col-gutter: 44px;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: -34px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .dp-page {
    --canvas-pad-x: 18px;
    --col-spec: 300px;
    --col-gutter: 40px;
    --panel-pad-x: 20px;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 58%;
  }
  .dp-hand-1,
  .dp-hand-box {
    width: 118px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .dp-top {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    row-gap: 30px;
  }
  .dp-divider {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-callout {
    left: 0;
    top: -24px;
  }
  .dp-panel-outer {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-resize {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-column {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .dp-annotation {
    position: static;
    display: block;
    width: auto;
    transform: none;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
  .dp-hand-star {
    display: none;
  }
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .dp-record-grid,
  .dp-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .spec-title {
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 32px;
  }
  .dp-tab {
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 12px;
    font-size: 9px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dp-page *,
  .dp-page *::before,
  .dp-page *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .dp-collapse {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .dp-shell,
  .dp-canvas,
  .dp-record,
  .dp-note,
  .dp-related-row,
  .dp-api-scroll {
    border: 1px solid CanvasText;
  }
  .dp-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
    border: 1px solid Highlight;
  }
  .dp-page::before,
  .dp-grain::after,
  .dp-note::before {
    display: none;
  }
}
